checks_run.procedure: Adversarial verification of F-DG2-160. Source review of the shared predicate and every call site. Re-run of the unchanged round-3 repro zz-sec-r3-invisible.test.ts on a disposable PG, twice. Schema-level matrix (freeText/hasText/name/reason) over the 18 round-3 code points plus extra Cf/fillers, Default_Ignorable code points outside Cf, combining marks alone and visible controls. An exhaustive sweep of \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}. Timing on strings of up to 10^7 invisible code units (ReDoS).
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 55591|55592 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r3-invisible.test.ts zz-sec-r4-probe.test.ts zz-sec-r4-oidc.test.ts --reporter=verbose; node probes/schema-unicode-matrix.mts $TMPDIR/review-probe/packages/shared
checks_run.environment: disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-probe @e37f6ea4, Node v22.22.2 (matrix: v24.21.0), PostgreSQL 16.13 (nested user ns, 127.0.0.1)
checks_run.expected: the round-3 repro passes (invisible-only Out of scope rejected or never documented); the matrix rejects every F-DG2-160 code point; visible text is accepted; the predicate is linear-time
checks_run.actual: zz-sec-r3-invisible.test.ts 5/5 PASS in both runs: U+0085, U+200B, U+200F, U+061C and U+2060x3 Out of scope -> 400, not stored. Matrix: all 18 round-3 code points and 11 more Cf/filler inputs are rejected by freeText (validation.blank) and name/reason (validation.blank, or too_small when trim already empties them), and hasText is false. Arabic+RLM, emoji ZWJ and leading-ZWSP text are ACCEPTED verbatim. Timing: hasVisibleContent on 10^7 invisible code units takes 151-216 ms, roughly linear (10^6: 13-15 ms). Residual: 4032 of 4174 Default_Ignorable code points still count as visible (assigned: U+034F, U+17B4-17B5, U+180B-180D, U+180F, U+FE00-FE0F, U+E0100-E01EF). This class is outside the reported set, so it is raised as F-DG2-180 (Low). F-DG2-160 is CLOSED_VERIFIED.

checks_run.expected: no server-side blank decision by trim(); every free-text body field goes through freeText or trimmedText
checks_run.actual: No server-side free-text blank decision uses trim(). The remaining trim() calls are: oidc.ts:167 (after hasText, see F-DG2-181); good-outcome.ts:59 (activity-verb lead detection, not presence); charter.ts:157-159 thesisPartText (followed by hasText); direction.ts:38 (sentence count); config/db bootstrap (P0 installer inputs, not API). The inline z.string().min/max schemas left are non-free-text (search q, cursor, idempotency key, OIDC query params, identity subject/issuer, csrfToken). No parseBody(z....) inline free-text parser remains.

checks_run.procedure: Probe the shared reasonRequest reuse in register-kit.ts (POST .../tom-gaps/{id}/archive) and evidence/routes.ts (POST .../evidence-links/{id}/remove), in zz-sec-r4-probe.test.ts parts A and B, on a disposable PG, twice. Steps: read-only auditor with a valid and with a blank reason; outsider (another transformation's lead); 5 invisible reasons with a valid If-Match; strict body (extra key); missing and stale If-Match; then a valid reason. Audit rows are counted per request id and per record. The same invocation runs the residual demonstrations (part C, zz-sec-r4-oidc.test.ts test 2), which fail by design, so the process exit is 1.
checks_run.expected: auditor 403 + 1 denial audit (also with a blank reason: authz before validation); outsider 403/404; blank 400 validation.blank at /reason, nothing written, 0 audit rows; missing If-Match 428; stale 409; valid 200 with exactly one archive/remove audit event
checks_run.actual: Parts A and B PASS in both runs. Auditor [403, forbidden, [authorization.denied]]; auditor with a blank reason 403; outsider 404; RLM x3, NEL+WJ+NBSP+ZWSP, ALM x4, U+3164 x3 and RLO+LRI+PDI each [400, validation, /reason:validation.blank, 0 audit]; extra key 400; missing If-Match 428 precondition_required; stale 409 version_conflict; the TOM gap was still open v1 with archiveReason null and the link still active v1 with remove_reason null; the valid reason gave 200 archived v2 with the reason trimmed and exactly one tom_gap.archive; the link gave removed v2 and audit [evidence_link.create, evidence_link.remove]. Part C (F-DG2-180) and OIDC test 2 (F-DG2-181) failed by design (7 failed | 8 passed).

checks_run.procedure: OIDC displayNameOf change. Source: confirm display_name is used only at the JIT app_user insert, and that binding (iss, sub), the e-mail bind, sessions and scoped assignments never read it. Probe zz-sec-r4-oidc.test.ts against the candidate's local fake OpenID Provider on its own scratch database. Admin issuer check: source review of the ordering, plus admin.test.ts in the integration runs.

checks_run.expected: the change affects the display-name choice only; identity, session and authorization are unchanged; a blank issuer is 400 at /identity/issuer

Test 1 PASS in both runs: an invisible-only name falls back to preferred_username 'r4.user'; a second login with the same (iss, sub) and a different invisible name signs in the same user; 0 scoped_assignment rows. Test 2 FAIL (by design) in both runs: name = 200 x U+200B + visible text gives a 200-code-unit display name with hasText = false, raised as F-DG2-181 (Low, display only). Admin: the check moved from trim() === '' to !hasVisibleContent, in the same place (after parseBody, before requireOrgPermission, as before). admin.test.ts (11) passes in both integration runs, including the spaces, RLM x2, WJ and NEL issuer cases.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of the web form diff: Form.tsx, ReasonDialog, RecordForm, RowActions, Section, CharterPage, DefinePage, DecisionsPage, GateDetailPage, JourneysSection. Check that no form can now send a request the server should refuse, that client validation is never the only guard, and that no test assertion was removed. Server refusal is confirmed by blank-text.test.ts (integration) and SEC-R4-03.
checks_run.expected: blank text is refused inline with the shared hasText; free text is sent verbatim ('' = no value); the server remains the authoritative guard; no weakened tests
checks_run.actual: Every hand-written P2 form, plus ReasonDialog and NoteDecisionDialog, refuses non-empty text without visible content inline (Form.tsx isBlankText = value !== '' && !hasText(value)); RecordForm applies it to the text, textarea and url kinds. The text is sent verbatim, and a server 400 on the field's pointer lands on the field. Anything the client misses is refused by the server: the shared freeText/reason schemas, blank-text.test.ts 20/20 in both integration runs, and my probes. A charter edit whose only change is the changeSummary is no longer sent (annotation). The test diffs only add lines, apart from a reformatted it.each in exclusions.test.ts, which keeps its cases and adds one. No new XSS sink: text is rendered as React text nodes.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-160 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. One shared visible-content predicate (White_Space + Cf + fillers) backs freeText, hasText and the shared name/reason. The round-3 repro passes 5/5 in two runs, every reported code point is rejected, and the regex is linear. The archive/remove reason reuse keeps authz-first 403s, If-Match 428/409 and exactly-once audit, and a blank reason is a 400 that writes nothing. The OIDC change affects only the JIT display name. The web forms add inline checks, and the server stays the guard. All required checks pass: build, typecheck, lint, openapi 161, no-cdn, format; unit 616/616 on Node 22 and 24, also under load; integration 465/465 twice with 19 migrations, contract, blank-text and the AUD-403 sweep; historical DG0/DG1. Two new Low, non-mandatory findings: F-DG2-180 (Default_Ignorable non-Cf code points such as U+FE0F/U+034F still count as content) and F-DG2-181 (the OIDC display name is truncated after the visibility check).
